design_read.product: Editorial AI feed reader + discovery hub for design-conscious technical readers
design_read.tokens: Fraunces display + Manrope body in apps/web/app/global.css
design_read.verdict: Typography and calm empty-state card align with premium editorial intent; corpus-empty guard collapses filter UX and creates silent deep links — largest gap vs 10-star reader.

findings.title: Default /reader shows generic corpus-empty UI with no chips or filter rail
findings.observation: Production GET /reader renders identical empty state: h1 'No prepared article corpus', Browse sources + Load live sample. No filter rail, #reader-search, or active chips. Matches corpusEmpty && overlayCount===0 early return.
findings.impact: Clean empty desk; filters unavailable until live load.
findings.recommendation: Always render filter chrome or pass filter context into empty variant.

findings.title: q=agent: Results heading and Search chip absent on empty corpus
findings.observation: /reader?q=agent renders same HTML as default. Playwright: 0 Search chips, h2 null. URL parses q but UI silent until Load live sample.
findings.impact: Deep-link search filters invisible; chip-clear UX untestable on prod cold start.
findings.recommendation: Show contextual empty copy + applied chips when state has query.

findings.title: source_type=blog and other URL filters silent in empty state
findings.observation: All filter URL variants collapse to generic empty. ReaderFilterRail only mounts after early-return guard passes.
findings.impact: Catalog deep links with filters look unfiltered.
findings.recommendation: Lift filter summary/chips outside corpus guard.

findings.title: Hub nav split-brain: PRIMARY_HUB_NAV vs FumaDocs baseOptions links
findings.observation: PRIMARY_HUB_NAV includes Home, no GitHub. baseOptions().links omits Home, adds external GitHub. Users see different nav on / vs /docs.
findings.impact: Orientation friction; Home unreachable from docs chrome; GitHub only on docs.
findings.recommendation: Single SSOT nav config consumed by hub header and layout.shared.tsx.

findings.title: Command palette (⌘K) only on (home) layout, absent on /docs
findings.observation: HubProviders + CommandPalette wired in app/(home)/layout.tsx only. Docs layout uses FumaDocs without palette.
findings.impact: Power users lose global jump nav when reading docs.
findings.recommendation: Mount CommandPalette in docs layout or root layout with route-aware items.

findings.title: No hub-visible theme toggle despite theme-manager.ts
findings.observation: useTheme exists for charts; no header/footer toggle on hub routes. Dark mode only via system or programmatic .dark.
findings.impact: Dark-mode reader/docs polish unaudited in CI; user preference not discoverable.
findings.recommendation: Add ThemeToggle to hub shell + docs; snapshot E2E in light/dark.

findings.title: Link color transitions ignore prefers-reduced-motion
findings.observation: global.css applies 150ms color/opacity transition on all anchors without reduced-motion guard.
findings.impact: Minor vestibular/accessibility friction for reduced-motion users.
findings.recommendation: Wrap transitions in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

findings.title: axe: 0 violations on / and /reader empty shell
findings.observation: axe-playwright on production HTML for / and /reader empty states reports zero violations.
findings.impact: Baseline a11y solid for empty states; full workspace + dark unaudited live.
findings.recommendation: Extend axe matrix to post-live-sample reader and dark theme.

findings.title: Compact layout typed in prefs but no Compact toggle in filter form
findings.observation: ReaderFiltersForm props include layout compact + onLayoutChange; UI only renders Cards and List buttons (LayoutGrid, List icons).
findings.impact: Users cannot discover compact density; URL/prefs path may set compact without UI affordance.
findings.recommendation: Add third layout button or segmented control for Compact.

findings.title: Live refresh always sorts overlay with compareByPublishedDesc
findings.observation: use-reader-live-refresh accepts sort param but .sort(compareByPublishedDesc) hardcoded at lines 107 and 170. sort=oldest URL ignored for live overlay merge.
findings.impact: Sort filter misleading after live load; inconsistent with corpus sort behavior.
findings.recommendation: Use sort-aware comparator from lib/reader sort helpers.

findings.title: Reset/Clear all does not clear feed= URL param
findings.observation: resetDrafts clears q, source_type, topics, verified, reader_view, sort, cursor but not feed.
findings.impact: Users expect Clear all to fully reset workspace; feed-scoped view persists.
findings.recommendation: Include feed: null in resetDrafts or rename control to 'Clear filters'.

findings.title: Mobile 'Filters and view' details summary tap target borderline
findings.observation: When workspace visible, mobile filter rail uses <details> summary; tap area may fall below 44px min on some breakpoints.
findings.impact: Harder to open filters on phone after corpus populated.
findings.recommendation: Increase summary min-height/padding; verify 44×44px hit target.

findings.title: /dashboard and /docs absent from route-stabilization publicRoutes
findings.observation: PRIMARY_HUB_NAV includes Dashboard and Docs but E2E matrix skips them. /offline included; /dashboard and /docs not.
findings.impact: Regressions on hub-adjacent surfaces ship undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add both routes to publicRoutes with stable heading assertions.

findings.title: Home hero CTAs route correctly but reader empty is default prod landing for Reader nav
findings.observation: Home → Reader CTA lands on corpus-empty /reader. Expected for prod but onboarding could set expectations earlier.
findings.impact: First-time users may not understand Load live sample step.
findings.recommendation: Home copy or reader empty cross-link explaining corpus vs live sample.

findings.title: Home → Reader → Preview works after Load live sample
findings.observation: Playwright: 21 articles after live sample, #reader-search present, 0 console errors. Preview flow requires explicit sample load first.
findings.impact: Core reading loop functional post-bootstrap.
findings.recommendation: Auto-suggest or soft-bootstrap live sample on first visit (product decision).

findings.title: Sources catalog → reader?feed= deep link works in E2E; empty corpus still gates UI
findings.observation: E2E covers feed= navigation; prod empty state hides feed chip until overlay populated.
findings.impact: Source-scoped reader links feel broken until live load.
findings.recommendation: Show feed chip in empty/filter summary (depends on FIX-001).

findings.title: Dashboard charts use theme-manager but hub lacks theme toggle for verification
findings.observation: Dashboard loads 200; chart theming tied to useTheme. Dark chart contrast not live-audited.
findings.impact: Analytics readability in dark unknown.
findings.recommendation: Pair dashboard with theme toggle + visual regression.

findings.title: Docs chrome diverges from hub (nav, palette, typography context)
findings.observation: FumaDocs sidebar + baseOptions nav differs from PRIMARY_HUB_NAV hub header on product routes.
findings.impact: Product feels like two apps; breaks editorial unity.
findings.recommendation: Align docs header links + optional shared hub strip.

findings.title: Draft vs applied filter model is sound when workspace visible
findings.observation: Apply filters / Reset pattern, topic draft chips vs stream applied chips — intentional separation per code review.
findings.impact: Good URL-sync architecture once chrome mounts.
findings.recommendation: Add pending-changes indicator near Apply (polish).

findings.title: Keyboard shortcut matrix (16 shortcuts) not live-verified on production
findings.observation: controls-registry lists j/k/m/s/a/v/r/, g-*, Escape, ?, b. Live prod audit did not execute full KB matrix (blocked by empty guard for stream shortcuts).
findings.impact: Power-user affordances may regress silently.
findings.recommendation: E2E keyboard spec post live-sample bootstrap in CI.
